prompt_text: Who is the best roofing company in Dallas for a roof replacement?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there’s no single objectively “best” roofing company — the right one depends on your needs (residential vs commercial, budget, shingle type, warranty expectations, whether it’s an insurance claim, etc.). I can, however, help you find highly rated, trustworthy roofers in Dallas and tell you how to pick the best for your job.

Quick next step: tell me your ZIP code and whether this is a residential or commercial replacement (and if you’re dealing with an insurance claim). I’ll pull a short list of top-rated local roofers and what makes each one a good choice.

How to choose the best roofing company (checklist)
- Get at least 3 written estimates that list scope of work, materials/brands, number of shingles per square, underlayment type, ventilation work, cleanup, permit handling, and timeline.
- Verify insurance and licensing: contractor should carry general liability and workers’ comp (or provide a waiver). Confirm they’ll pull required Dallas permits and inspections.
- Check reviews and reputation: Google Reviews, BBB, Angi/HomeAdvisor, Yelp, and local Facebook groups. Ask for local references and recent job photos.
- Warranties: confirm both manufacturer shingle warranty and the contractor’s workmanship warranty (written, length, and transferability).
- Payment terms: avoid large upfront payments (>20–30%); use a payment schedule tied to milestones. Get lien waivers when final payment is made.
- Materials & installation details: 30-year vs 50-year shingles, ice-and-water shield in eaves/valleys, proper underlayment, drip edge, flashing, ridge/soffit ventilation, full tear-off vs overlay.
- Storm-chaser warning: avoid door-to-door contractors after storms unless they’re local and verifiable. Get multiple bids.
- Red flags: extremely low bid, no written contract, demand for full cash up front, poor communication, no local references.

What good Dallas roofers typically offer
- Local experience with Dallas building codes and storm/ hail claims
- Permit handling and inspections
- Certified installers for major shingle brands (GAF, CertainTeed, Owens Corning)
- Clear written warranties and cleanup (magnetic sweep)

If you want, I can:
- Provide a curated list of top-rated Dallas roof replacement companies near you (need ZIP code)
- Draft an email template you can send to contractors requesting bids
- Give a one-page checklist to use when they meet you onsite
